results.source_boundaries: Carts response fields; outbound Orders Shipment request fields; Station decoded entity fields. Database/network internal histories excluded.
results.negative_relation_scope: Supplementary per-execution field-role nondependence checks; not pooled as extra target-instance queries.

families.path: Orders Shipment.id/name → Shipping → Orders returned shipment

audit.scope: Corruption tests replay temporary copies; independent RPC protocol admission is separate from provenance inference; renaming is a static model check.

background_unknown_observations.reason: Value changed outside counted application writes; no forwarding edge

limits: Only selected paths under explicit bytecode/default-Jackson/HTTP contracts; not arbitrary JVM programs or all application fields.
Carts source boundary is its response field observation, excluding its database history. Shipment source boundary is the outgoing Orders DTO, excluding upstream customer-id computation.
Train Ticket source boundary is a decoded Station entity getter read, not Mongo storage provenance; missing-station constant null is modeled from actual bytecode.
Object/declared-field/application-write count plus observation/message instance is scored; counters are not complete JVM/reflective store histories or database versions.
One common JVM observer/reconstructor with explicit generic framework/library models. Query endpoints and workload oracles remain application-specific configuration.
